news.title: Terrence Shannon Jr. scores career-high 34 points as Timberwolves beat Trail Blazers 106-98
news.text: — Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 12 of his career-high 34 points in the second quarter as the Minnesota Timberwolves recovered from a slow start to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-98 on Monday night in the opener of a two-game set.
